      Changelog — 2026-07-28

      • All UI labels in English (good / medium / bad — no Dutch goed/slecht).
      • Country names in English: Switzerland / France / Italy / Spain (not MIDI_CH etc.).
      • UK CV (IUK), UK LCV (ITUK), Israel LCV (UMI IDS pack — never blended with UTI), Norway (RSA).
      • Benelux kept; Belgium, Netherlands and Luxembourg also shown as separate countries.
      • Overview strengths / weak points: per section A–E, based on max-point items (full score = good, zero = bad) — not “first question in section”.
      • Dealer total score shown as percentage (Score % of 280); GPS context on feedback packs prefers capture % where available.
